author: Shibata
quote: Overhyped when I saw 99 rating on the game by critics after playing the game I understood they lied big time!! I wasn't going to review this game but after 13 years buying a console to just play it I need to leave my comment. Let's start with the story about Jason and **** boring and doesn't makes me attached to any of them Jason voice actor is just bad. You start the game by doing a lot of shores for Lucia as Jason which i found them to be very depressing. After a few hours in I started getting excited with the gunfights and a bit more action but then started drying out again. I started feeling I was in a simulator trying to please my virtual girlfriend all the time instead of doing GTA stuff... Saw a few bugs like textures popping the character getting inside walls and yes it was really hard for me to get used to the 30 fps but i managed to cope with it. Great graphics really good interactions the small details were there but they failed with the rest.  I have played every single Rockstar game and was never disappointed but GTA 6 clearly wasn't the case. I would give it a higher score but because of the misleading critic reviews I have to leave it at 0.
